## About imvu.js

**imvu.js** is a lightweight Node.js library for interacting with your own public IMVU rooms and their users, or for creating custom bots using an event-driven API.

Designed to be simple, efficient, and beginner-friendly.


## Disclaimer

**imvu.js** must be used in accordance with IMVU’s Terms and Conditions. We reserve the right to limit or revoke access to the API for any user who violates these terms.

This project is not intended for illegal activities, harassment, spam, or any action that may negatively affect the experience of users on the IMVU platform. You are solely responsible for how you use the API.

This project does not support creating an API for rooms that are not owned by the user.


## Installation

To install **imvu.js**, run the following command in your terminal:

```bash
npm i imvu.js
```

## Getting Your Token
To obtain your token, you must register on our platform at [https://imvu.js.org](https://imvu.js.org).


## Login Example
Here is an example of how to log in and spawn furniture:

```javascript
const IMVU = require('imvu.js')

const imvu = new IMVU({ outfit: [80, 191], seat: "-1 0", show_online: true });
imvu.on('ready', () => {
  console.log(`Bot ${imvu.display_name} with ID ${imvu.id} successfully connected to room ${imvu.room.id}`);
  //Bot IMVUJS with ID 123 successfully connected to room 321
});

imvu.login('YOUR_TOKEN');
```

## Usage Examples
Here are some examples of how to use **imvu.js**:

```javascript
imvu.on('message', async (message) => {
  if (message.user.bot) return;

  if (message.content == '!Ping') {
    await imvu.say('Pong');
    // Additional action, if necessary...
    await message.user.kick();
  }
});

imvu.on('seat', async (data) => {
  const { seat, seat_id, leave, user } = data; 
  // An elevator with auth?
  if (seat.instance_id === 35 && user.isMod) {
    const mod_room = { x: 100, y: 5000 };
    seat.set(mod_room)
  } else if (seat.instance_id === 35) {
    // Send a whisper
    user.say('[Bot] - Please leave this spot or you will be kicked in 5 seconds');
    setTimeout(async () => {
      if (user.furniture.id === seat.id) {
        const debug = await user.kick();
        console.log(debug);
        // {error: 'Bot does not have moderator permissions in your room'}
      }
    }, 5000);
  }
  // Let's move it back
  if (leave.instance_id === 35) {
    leave.set({
      x:0,
      y:0,
      z:0
    })
  }
});

imvu.on('join', async (user) => {
  if (user.bot) return;
  // Welcome message
  imvu.say(`Welcome ${user.display_name} to my wonderful room`)
  // Or... perhaps a whisper? (Platinum VIP is still required.)
  user.say(`Welcome ${user.display_name} to my wonderful room`);

  // Get the entrance furniture, can use getById or get
  const entrance = imvu.furnitures.getById(0) || imvu.furnitures.get({instance_id: 0});
  // Lets move the bot to the entrance of the room.
  entrance.move()
});

imvu.on('leave', async (user) => {
  if (user.bot) return;
  // Additional actions, if necessary...
});

imvu.on('furniture_update', async (furniture) => {
  // Additional actions, if necessary...
});
```

For more references and example codes, check the complete documentation.
